Explain and practise: count subarrays with fixed count

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

## Count Subarrays With Fixed Count

```cpp
long long countSubarrays(vector<int>& A, int minK, int maxK) {
    long res = 0, jbad = -1, jmin = -1, jmax = -1, n = A.size();
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (A[i] < minK || A[i] > maxK) jbad = i;
        if (A[i] == minK) jmin = i;
        if (A[i] == maxK) jmax = i;
        res += max(0L, min(jmin, jmax) - jbad);
    }
    return res;
}
```
